description: Initial doctrine tree for public/demo-safe HK criminal procedure and evidence case-to-proposition graph building.

nodes.label: HK Criminal Procedure And Evidence
nodes.description: Root node for criminal procedure and evidence proposition cards.

nodes.label: Pleadings / Charge / Indictment
nodes.description: Sufficiency, amendment, particulars, duplicity, variance, and statement of offence issues.

nodes.label: Burden Of Proof
nodes.description: Legal burden, evidential burden, reverse burden, and prosecution burden issues.

nodes.label: Standard Of Proof
nodes.description: Beyond reasonable doubt, civil standards on preliminary issues, and related directions.

nodes.label: Admissibility
nodes.description: Threshold admissibility, relevance, exclusion, and voir dire issues.

nodes.label: Confession Evidence
nodes.description: Voluntariness, oppression, inducement, fairness, and admission of confession evidence.

nodes.label: Voir Dire
nodes.description: Procedure for determining disputed admissibility issues before the tribunal of fact.

nodes.label: Identification Evidence
nodes.description: Visual identification, recognition, parade/procedure issues, and warning directions.

nodes.label: Hearsay
nodes.description: Hearsay rule, statutory gateways, exceptions, reliability, and confrontation/fairness issues.

nodes.label: Similar Fact / Propensity Evidence
nodes.description: Similar fact evidence, propensity, probative value, prejudice, and exclusion.

nodes.label: Right To Silence
nodes.description: Silence in investigation, interview, trial, adverse inference, and fairness issues.

nodes.label: Abuse Of Process
nodes.description: Stay, oppressive prosecution, manipulation of procedure, inconsistent positions, and integrity of justice.

nodes.label: Delay
nodes.description: Delay affecting fairness, prejudice, lost evidence, and stay applications.

nodes.label: Bail
nodes.description: Bail pending trial or appeal, risk factors, conditions, and review.

nodes.label: Appeal / Review
nodes.description: Appeal routes, conviction/sentence review, fresh evidence, and miscarriage of justice issues.

nodes.label: Judicial Discretion
nodes.description: Discretion to exclude evidence, manage trial fairness, give directions, or grant procedural relief.
